name: supine windshield wipers
description: Lying on your back, you swing the legs side to side like wipers. It strengthens the obliques and trunk control.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides, palms down.
Lift your legs straight up over your hips.
Lower both legs to one side without touching the floor.
Bring them back up through the middle.
Lower to the other side and keep alternating.
